No context flattening patch exists
PNOA bare-backshore mask excludes generic trees without modifying the water or terrain
Individually mapped trees avoid enclosed building footprints
Six dated photographic upper windows distinguish the former school
Chapel is flat-roofed, matching the photograph and PNOA
Coastal-vegetation mask compacts world-positioned matrices, colours, counts and bounds
Coastal-vegetation masking is idempotent and reports its own count
Final terrain rebinding disposes and replaces every prior geometry
Architecture is rebound together with roads and vegetation
Instances own separate materials and textures
dispose is idempotent and releases all currently owned resources
